rewriteInstruction: The draft is structurally sound and evidence-grounded — the three H3 blocks map cleanly to the three messaging elements. Fix four things: (1) Split the fourth paragraph so no single paragraph carries more than two ideas and stays under 60 words. (2) In the third H3 block, move the finding ('the page now speaks to multiple buyer roles simultaneously') to sentence one — do not save it for the end. (3) Define 'category' in plain language on first use so a founder who has never read a positioning framework understands what it means in practice. (4) Add a condition to the causal claim in H3-1 — the evidence supports the inference, not the mechanism, so hedge it with 'if' or 'this is consistent with.' The final test is good but make it tighter by referencing the specific before/after Foreplay copy the reader just read, rather than asking them to audit their own page in the abstract.
